newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks open slightly lower after U.S. fall.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks open slightly lower after U.S. fall.

text.p: Tokyo stocks opened slightly lower on Thursday, as participants became cautious of the key average's recent gains without a pause after U.S. stocks slipped overnight, brokers said.
But some high-tech shares continued to extend gains, supporting the bottom side of the index, they said.
At 0015 GMT, the 225-share Nikkei average was down 56.90 points or 0.28 percent at 20,554.66. Its June futures was off 10 points at 20,540.
